items.content_html: ReadAbleI is a web app that helps people with visual impairments or reading difficulties. Users can upload images, extract text via OCR, listen to it aloud with built-in TTS, and even translate it into other languages. Built with React (Vite) and Tesseract.js, it’s fast, lightweight, and fully browser-based.
